name: Deco

identity.oneLiner: Jazz-age geometry: stepped edges, vertical emphasis, brass on lacquer.
identity.summary: Art Deco as structure, not costume stickers. Stepped corners, fan/chevron rules, high-contrast lacquer surfaces, and disciplined brass accents. Vertical rhythm and symmetry beat busy motifs.
identity.authenticityNotes: Prefer stepped geometry and metal edge over random sunbursts. Ornament is architectural, not stickered.

axes.shape: Stepped / chamfered corners; vertical emphasis; symmetric blocks
axes.surface: Lacquer panels, subtle linen/noise, high contrast fields
axes.elevation: Terraced stacks (hard steps) more than soft blur shadows
axes.ornament: Chevrons, fan rules, thin brass lines via frame/ornament slots
axes.typeVoice: Elegant display for titles; restrained body; generous tracking on labels
axes.motion: Measured, linear accents; reveal like curtains, not bouncy
axes.iconography: Geometric line icons; mirrored where possible

bands.description: Structure hints only: radius, type voice, subtle edge. No ornaments.
Clear era geometry and materials; sparse ornaments on surfaces. Alias: signature.
Full decorative program — applied when data-fidelity-band is absent. Demo/showcase territory; neverDo still binds.

dialects.label: Streamline
dialects.description: Softer curves, poster moderne; less stepped, more speed-lines.

neverDo: Never put Cinzel/display faces on Button or TextField labels.
Never use neon pink/cyan — Deco metal is brass/gold/silver, not synthwave.
Never scatter sunburst SVGs on every card; one architectural motif per surface max.
Never soft-blur elevation as the primary model — prefer terraced steps.
Glow never counts toward contrast; lacquer text must pass AA on fills alone.

lines: fidelity: costume default; bands whisper|standard|costume (default deprecated alias of standard)
never: neon glow, display type on controls

card.shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-gold) 70%, transparent), 0 6px 0 0 var(--ew-color-border-strong), 0 12px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-fg-default) 22%, transparent)
card.raisedShadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-gold) 70%, transparent), 0 6px 0 0 var(--ew-color-border-strong), 0 14px 0 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--ew-color-fg-default) 28%, transparent)
